data.title: ICU Staff Nurse
data.fitReason: 4 years of direct ICU patient care in a general hospital is a near-perfect match for this role. High-acuity case management, emergency response skills, and medical records proficiency align precisely with ICU staff nurse requirements at mid-level hospitals in Can Tho.

data.title: Senior Clinical Nurse – General Hospital
data.fitReason: ICU experience combined with new nurse training responsibilities signals readiness for a senior clinical nursing designation. Private hospitals in Can Tho actively promote nurses with 4+ years and demonstrated mentorship duties into senior clinical tracks.

data.title: Charge Nurse – ICU/Ward
data.fitReason: The candidate's training of new nurses and ICU competency are the two primary prerequisites for a charge nurse role. While no formal leadership title has been held, the functional experience maps closely to shift-level supervisory duties expected at this level.

data.title: Clinical Trainer – Nursing Staff
data.fitReason: Documented experience training new nurses is a direct qualification for a clinical trainer position. Combined with ICU clinical depth, the candidate can credibly deliver onboarding and skills training programs at hospitals or nursing schools in Can Tho.

data.title: Emergency Department Nurse
data.fitReason: First aid and emergency response skills alongside ICU experience make this candidate a strong fit for ED nursing. Private hospitals expanding emergency services in the Mekong Delta region are actively hiring nurses with high-acuity backgrounds.

data.title: Outpatient Clinic Nurse Supervisor
data.fitReason: Medical records management and patient communication skills, paired with peer training experience, make this candidate viable for supervisory nursing roles in outpatient or polyclinic settings. Less technically demanding than ICU but leverages the candidate's administrative and interpersonal competencies.

data.title: Healthcare Quality Assurance Coordinator
data.fitReason: Medical records management and clinical process familiarity from 4 years of hospital practice provide a functional base for QA coordination roles. The candidate would need supplemental training in QA frameworks, but private hospitals in Can Tho often promote experienced nurses into this pathway.

data.title: School or Occupational Health Nurse
data.fitReason: First aid skills, patient communication, and general clinical experience meet the baseline requirements for occupational or school health nurse roles. These positions are less competitive and offer stable employment, though they underutilize the candidate's ICU specialization.

data.title: Home Care Nurse – Private Client Services
data.fitReason: ICU-level clinical competency and patient care skills are highly valued in private home care, especially for post-surgical or elderly patients. Growing demand among Can Tho's aging and middle-class population creates openings, though income may be variable depending on client volume.

data.title: Medical Content Reviewer – Health Platform
data.fitReason: Clinical nursing knowledge and medical records experience provide foundational credibility for reviewing health-related content on digital health platforms or insurance companies. This is an emerging role type in Vietnam's healthtech sector, though English proficiency gaps and lack of digital experience reduce near-term fit.
